raw_observed_text:
익숙한 길을 천천히 걸으며
빛, 소리, 사람의 흔적을 만납니다.
스쳐 지나간 풍경에서
새로운 이야기를 발견해보세요.

located_observations.observation: Two bold Myeongjo title lines read as the main typographic anchor. Complete Hangul forms and wide interior spaces are visible.
Four left-aligned body lines read continuously with consistent baseline, word gaps, and commas/periods. They occupy less than half the screen width.
Title is the first text anchor, followed by the tall alley silhouette, orange upper-right window and a descending footprint chain; the paragraph is grouped at lower left.

Pictorial stairs, foreground paving and receding buildings form a recognizable alley. Multiple dark banks are divided by a pale road; the large black body is not the assigned single diagonal connected mass.
Footprints are broad black positive blotches on ivory, rather than elongated bright cuts within the connected black silhouette.
A single orange plane lights a window; windows and fine wires identify looking upward during urban walking.
Chipped ivory edges and speckled black ink maintain a carved print finish; the body typography has no image cuts through its characters.

layout.observations: Title wraps at word boundary into two lines; body wraps at word boundaries into four stable lines.
